== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His name was previously Park Gi-tae (박기태).
* Dubbed by Twitch chat as "Lord Morgan" when performing well.
* He has a large fan base in Vietnam (on par with the top LCK players). People often call him "Ngài" (Lord or Sir) and spam the crocodile (🐊) icon every time he picks Renekton.
